results.comment: 7:36 I don't see anyone in the comments section answering your boning/zip ties question so here's the answer 6 months late lol.   Boning for bodices were historically made of steel or baleen aka whale bone. Steel is expensive and can't be washed and whale bone is illegal because whales are a protected species. Today we use synthetic baleen (which is more sturdy and rigid) made of extruded polyester or plastic boning (which is more flexible and affordable) both of which you can buy by the yard to cut down to the correct size.  Plastic boning is the go to method for modern dress construction ala the prom or wedding dress due to it's affordability and availability. Industrial zip ties (not the thin flimsy ones but the thicc boys that come in 36"+ lengths) are much cheaper and are basically the same as plastic boning.  19:53 You wanted to know how she got her skirt to be this full?
